scope: Site-wide accessibility release preparation with existing visual UI/copy preserved within accessibility changes. Actual VoiceOver/Orca integration is checked separately later.
runSummary: The saved full-build record inspected 230 Storybook files and 1,244 states with Chromium play/axe: 1,219 passed, 25 failed, none skipped. This does not establish complete accessibility preparation.

The recorded failures were 8 dangling notification IDREFs, 7 target-size failures, 3 contrast failures, 6 inline-link distinction failures and 1 unnamed math-block command. SourceEditor contrast was also detected in an earlier full run and remains a recheck item.
Six account scenarios per Korean/English locale and four actual 390×844 mobile-list cases were checked separately. Actual VoiceOver/Orca speech and full-screen pixel comparison were not run.
Story existence, source type checks and passing axe results do not establish every page semantic, reading order, state or user scenario.

statusMeaning.pending: Scope and review criteria are registered. Implementation/review is not complete.

phases: Register all entrypoints, branches and features; record existing copy and visual states as the baseline.
Review shared semantics, behavior and theme contracts first, then propagate corrections to consumers.
Review global navigation, login, permissions and account screens.
Review body content, settings, files, translations, collaboration and recovery in each actual editor page.
Review the actual output and navigation of public documents, entities, shared views and forms.
Review administration lists, settings, analytics and provider editors.
Check theme, language, viewport, permissions, asynchronous transitions and visual preservation on each page.
Later, check the same screens and interactions with macOS VoiceOver and Linux Orca. Track this separately from current preparation.
gates: Identify each control's purpose and target. Supply necessary names and preserve visible label wording. Do not hide identifying information only in a description.
Expose roles matching actual interactions and relationships among headings, labels, descriptions, errors, groups and panels. Distinguish decoration from meaningful content.
Values, selection, checked, expanded, read-only, disabled, required, invalid and progress states match actual data and permissions.
Provide meaningful document titles, landmarks, heading hierarchy and content order for structural navigation. CSS position alone does not establish reading order.
Every offered command has a keyboard path. Focus is appropriate after entry, changes, deletion and close; editor selection is preserved.
Communicate progress, success, failure and empty results when needed. Avoid unnecessary focus movement, duplicate announcements and excessive progress updates.
Reproduce applicable data, permissions, errors and transitions with typed local inputs and outputs connected to production UI.
Do not arbitrarily change visible copy, translation keys, placeholders, tooltips, date/number/unit/filename formatting, tokens, layout, density, colors, icons or sizes.
Distinguish a rendered screen from verified semantics and interaction. Assert names, roles, states, order, focus and transitions; review axe findings and incomplete results.
commonStates: Initial, normal, empty value/result, partial data, long values, loading, error and retry.
Applicable signed-out, user, author/owner, administrator, read-only, disabled and revoked-permission combinations.
Default, focus, selected, expanded, menu/dialog open, pending, success, failure, cancel and undo.
light/dark, Korean and supported locales, content/mixed languages, RTL, narrow/medium/wide viewports, zoom and reduced motion.
Actually offered editor, preview, public, shared, print and conversion outputs.

features.title: Copy and visual preservation
features.check: Compare visible copy, formatting, tokens and geometry before/after accessibility changes with identical data. Accessibility text must not leak into visible children, labels or titles. Record contrast/focus defects and review them at the shared visual owner.
notes: The recorded change modified/deleted none of 76,180 existing messages across 20 UI locales and added 19 accessibility-only keys to each locale. Full-screen visual comparison (D) was not run.

features.title: Buttons and icon commands
features.check: Check native button/link distinction, icon names, targets of repeated commands, pressed/disabled semantics, keyboard activation and absence of nested controls. Do not append role words such as button to every name.
notes: The saved RAC pending-button deletion case unmounted aria-labelledby targets retained by a live-announcement role=img, causing role-img-alt failure. Correct the upstream name lifetime; do not hide it with exclusions or by removing isPending.

features.title: Inputs and fields
features.check: Check field names, values, required state and description/error relationships. Names must not depend only on placeholders. Check entry, editing, paste and autocomplete; do not expand visible labels solely for accessibility.
notes: Field names, descriptions and errors were connected to actual inputs and contenteditable label-click focus was improved. Error, disabled and IME behavior remained under consumer review.

features.title: Selection and value adjustment
features.check: Check the actual checkbox/radio/switch/listbox/combobox/slider pattern, group name, current value, selection and arrow/keyboard operation. Do not give a decorative grid a selection role.
notes: SearchCombobox human-readable item text was connected to nine consumers. Selection/grid/Dnd/slider keyboard contracts remained under review.

features.title: Menus and popovers
features.check: Check trigger name, haspopup, expanded and relationships; arrow navigation, Escape and focus return. Distinguish menus from ordinary popovers and exclude hidden items from navigation.

features.title: Dialogs, drawers and confirmations
features.check: Check title, description, initial focus, background exclusion, focus containment/return and Escape/close paths. Do not use the entire long body as aria-describedby or announce it twice.

features.title: Tabs, disclosures and hierarchy
features.check: Check tablist/tab/tabpanel and disclosure/tree names, selection, relationships and arrow operation. Exclude hidden keepMounted controls from navigation and preserve state.

features.title: Document structure and navigation
features.check: Check page title, actual main/nav/aside landmarks, heading hierarchy, reading order and link purpose. Avoid excessive meaningless regions/names and exclude decorative icons.

features.title: Theme, contrast and focus
features.check: Check token-owned text, control and focus contrast against actual composited backgrounds. States must not rely only on color. Do not conceal inconsistencies with page-specific CSS.
notes: The saved 32 theme-contrast unit checks passed, while actual Display, PublicMetadata, ProcessingOverlay and SourceEditor states failed color-contrast in full rendering. Palette tests do not establish consumer contrast. Existing color/opacity/CSS was not arbitrarily changed in that run.
Six Login states failed link-in-text-block in the saved run. Preserve copy and review link distinction at the shared design owner.

features.title: Size, zoom and motion
features.check: Check clipping, overlap, obstruction, scroll traps, obscured focus, targets, menu/dialog placement, motion preference and logical direction. Consume existing breakpoint/density contracts.
notes: Marquee and meaningful immersive-scene pause/full-information navigation paths were incomplete in the saved record. An accessible name alone does not pass this scope. Extend shared behavior while respecting separately authorized visual scope.
The saved Chromium/axe run reported TableOfContents link target-size failures. Existing link height was approximately 19.6px; retaining that geometry does not establish a pass.

The saved Form Submissions run reported a DateRange Calendar trigger obscured by the following sort button. Its nominal 30×30 target exposed only approximately 23.8px width. Review width/layout rather than adding ARIA or an audit exclusion.

The full run also reported target-size failures in TextButton Inline, three DateTimeInput states and executable controls. Include these shared size/spacing consumers alongside contents links and DateRange overlap.

features.title: Language and existing formatting
features.check: Check lang/dir, translated accessible names, distinction between UI/content languages and existing date/number/unit/field wording. Do not copy accessibility names/descriptions into visible copy.

features.title: Notifications and progress
features.check: Check appropriate status/alert urgency, current value, target name and live-region registration/update without duplication. Always supply required semantics; tune optional announcement frequency to context.
notes: The saved RAC pending-button deletion case unmounted aria-labelledby targets retained by a live-announcement role=img, causing role-img-alt failure. Correct the upstream name lifetime; do not hide it with exclusions or by removing isPending.

The saved RAC Toast dismissal case similarly removed the title referenced by LiveAnnouncer. Recheck toast lifetime against the currently installed implementation before claiming this historical failure resolved.

features.title: Tables and mobile rows
features.check: Check header relationships, sorting, row identity, selection and targets of repeated row commands; inspect the same data in mobile representations and pagination.
notes: Nineteen of twenty administration lists and four actual 390×844 mobile cases passed the saved keyboard/axe checks. The remaining deletion case had a RAC pending-announcement dangling-IDREF lifetime failure. Empty action-column names use actual hidden translated text without changing displayed headers/width.

features.title: Reordering and resizing
features.check: Offered functionality is operable without dragging and exposes target, current position and result. Keep the leading handle and existing layout; restore appropriate focus after deletion.

features.title: Global search and language menu

features.title: Cookies, global notifications and route loading

features.title: List search, sorting and pagination

features.title: Row menus, bulk selection and changes

features.title: Editor header and metadata

features.title: Body input, selection and formatting
features.check: Check editor name, content, multiline and content language; character/word/line navigation, selection, edit, paste, breaks and format state. Preserve selection on entry/exit. A textbox name alone does not complete review.

features.title: Slash, selection and block menus
features.check: Check menu triggers, item purpose, filter/active item, formatting, shortcuts, Escape and editor selection return; provide alternatives to mouse/hover-only commands.

features.title: Block/section order and nesting
features.check: Check block type, position, hierarchy, selection, keyboard moves and focus after deletion. Distinguish same-named blocks; editor and published order agree.

features.title: Tables, links and equations
features.check: Check table-header/cell relationships and menus; link name/URL/purpose and editing dialog; readable equations; preserve semantics in exported/public output.

features.title: Code, diagrams and executable blocks
features.check: Check Monaco accessibility, Tab escape, code position and language; Mermaid/p5/Three source-result relationships, iframe name, alternative explanation and run/permission commands. Canvas cannot be the only interaction/information path.
notes: Code-editor/menu keyboard paths were improved, while adequate Mermaid/canvas alternatives still require authored-data and output contracts.
The unnamed equation command in public-block comparison is tracked under E08 N/R. It is not a math-render race; preserve MathML reading structure while separating control semantics.

features.title: File selection and library insertion
features.check: Check actual dialog, file picker, folder/filename, type, selection, insertion target and return to editor. File-input and drag/drop paths offer equivalent operation.
notes: FileLibraryPicker insertion/selection restrictions and permitted Enter preview are separate states. Review whole-row aria-disabled semantics against the independent preview contract.

features.title: Upload, processing and retry
features.check: Check file target/type, determinate/indeterminate progress, validation errors and recovery; recording-file selection/upload/insertion. File upload and recording creation inside the app are separate features.
notes: The saved TiptapMathNodeViews wrapper exposed role=button with an empty command name in both reading/editing states. aria-command-name also failed with fully rendered MathML. Separate equation reading content from selection controls; do not mask fractions/radicals with a temporary aria-label.

features.title: Images, cropping and alternatives
features.check: Check crop keyboard path, values/ranges, apply/cancel and upload outcome; image description, caption/decoration and persistence. Do not expand existing apply-button copy into an explanation.

features.title: Language, translation requests and recovery
features.check: Check current document/language, source versus translation, row-command targets, transitions, permissions, retry and focus/commands after cancel; content language after opening translation. Preserve displayed language names/codes.

features.title: Sharing, permission and relation panels
features.check: Check share target, permission scope, password/expiry, participant/tag/relation selection, repeated row commands and focus return. Inspect whether extensions are actually enabled at each consumer.
notes: A translation-request focus-loss defect caused by native disabled was corrected. Same-language cancellation and restored commands after completion were checked without stealing focus if the user had moved elsewhere.

features.title: Collaboration, session and save recovery
features.check: Check synchronization state, unavailable commands, revoked-permission/session dialogs, reauthentication/return, body retention and actual availability. Disconnected and readonly are separate states.

features.title: Version history and restoration
features.check: Check version, time, author, selection, comparison and restoration semantics; drawer/confirmation and editor return. Preserve existing date/time formatting.

features.title: Responsive body, settings and focus mode
features.check: Visible and accessible panels agree. Check tab names/relationships/selection, transition focus and retained input/selection; hidden settings controls are excluded from navigation.
notes: Body/settings persistence and responsive-mode transitions are separate. Recheck editor selection, local state and focus return when mobile/focused/desktop wrappers change.

features.title: Page sections, columns and block settings
features.check: Check all registered section kinds, settings fields, reordering, nesting, link/asset selection and generated output. A representative rich-text story does not complete all dynamic-page review.

features.title: Work credits and clients

The saved Form Submissions run reported a DateRange Calendar trigger obscured by the following sort button. Its nominal 30×30 target exposed only approximately 23.8px width. Review width/layout rather than adding ARIA or an audit exclusion.
